rows.notes: The document is a UF/IFAS extension publication (AE354) that summarises prior work on soil moisture sensor-based irrigation control; it reports no data, experiment, survey or model runs of its own. The water-saving figures it cites (e.g., 40-50%, 50%, 70%, 11%) come from other studies (Smajstrla and Locascio 1996; Dukes et al. 2003; Munoz-Carpena et al. 2004, 2005; Dukes and Scholberg 2005) and concern drip/subsurface drip systems, not sprinkler. The passage's claim of 80-90% efficiency for sprinkler with sensors versus 40-45% for surface irrigation does not appear anywhere in the document.

notes: Extension sheet, not a primary study; Q1 is no so all other questions are no. The claimed figures (80-90% vs 40-45%) are not found in the text.
